1.e4 d5 2.f4 dxe4 3.Nc3.strategy: Attacks the e4 pawn at once and brings a piece out: the natural way to try to win the pawn back before Black consolidates. The gambit works only if White's lead in development outweighs the pawn.

1.e4 d5 2.f4 dxe4 3.Nc3 Nf6.strategy: Defends the pawn with a developing move and prepares to bring the rest of the army out. Black keeps the extra pawn and White has no quick way to recover it, so White has to show real compensation in activity.
